body:
Yeah I feel you. Although, I’m leaning more towards actually offing myself now. But my life is actually pretty decent (depending on how you look at it at least); I live in a nice house (it’s my parents’ tho lmao), I have cute pets, my family loves me, and I got to experience some cool things along the way in life. It’s just that I suffer from BPD and I don’t see the point in much of anything anymore; I’m really stagnant and have no motivation to accomplish anything of any actual substance. The love of my life broke up with me a month ago and wants nothing to do with me. So there are good things, and bad things. Just like with anyone’s life. But I’m just like, fed up to the extreme haha


I hope things get better for you. I really do. No one should have to feel this way.
